    not: "dictionary key order by encoded key bytes; sorting StringName directly; owner-side canonical_bytes writers; Object/Callable/RID/Color in a payload; 'as' cast on a Variant"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    reason: "Equal states must give equal bytes and unequal states unequal bytes; value order is cheap in GDScript and readable in the G4 diff; StringName.sort() is not lexical and not a function of text (probed); a Dictionary merges String and StringName keys of equal text"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"integer_division_convention","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: integer_division_convention
    status: active           # ADR-0005 is Proposed; ADR-0010 owns the lint rules and the single annotated division
    api: "IntMath (this ADR owns the function list): trunc_div = a / b (the one annotated site), floor_div = trunc_div(a - posmod(a, b), b), ceil_div = floor_div(a + b - 1, b), posmod_i = the posmod builtin, lsr(x, n) for shifts of possibly negative values (1 <= n <= 63), low32; b <= 0 returns 0 with a debug assert; floor family for every quotient meant as a floor, trunc_div only where truncation toward zero is meant"
    not: "bare / or % or /= or %= on ints outside IntMath; arithmetic >> on a possibly negative value; hexadecimal literals above 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF; decimal literals above 9223372036854775807 (INT64_MIN is -9223372036854775807 - 1 or 1 << 63); shifting a negative literal; shift counts outside 1..63; reliance on integer wrap outside mix64/fnv64/Ihash/the fold"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    reason: "GDScript / and % truncate toward zero (probed -7/2 = -3); >> is arithmetic; the integer_division warning covers the binary / only (c /= b loads, probed) and no warning covers % or %=; a hex literal above int64 logs an error and saturates while the script still loads; a decimal literal just above int64 wraps silently; int wraps silently"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"keyed_rng_derivation","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: keyed_rng_derivation
    status: active           # ADR-0005 is Proposed; D.10 set-once (R-17)
    api: "rng_derive(world_seed, stream, counter) = mix64(world_seed ^ mix64(fnv64(name)) ^ (counter * GOLDEN)) with signed decimal constants; stream key computed once at registration; rng_derive_epoch adds RESTORE_KEY_STRIDE (2^20) * restore_epoch inside RngFacet.draw_epoch only; Ihash.h(variation_seed, k1, k2, k3, salt) for non-RNG variation and for truth-channel visuals that must be reproducible (Trail: world_seed as k3, fixed per-system seed)"
    not: "randi/randf/RandomNumberGenerator/shuffle/pick_random/hash() in sim; a sequential counter shared across unrelated subjects; owner code computing counter_eff; presentation calling rng_derive or DetRng.derive"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    reason: "Pure keyed draws replay from (seed, name, counter) with no hidden state; the D.10 goldens reproduce on 4.7.2 and in an independent Python reference; the sim never draws the trail.vis stream, so a world_seed-keyed Ihash reproduces it without opening the sim RNG API to presentation"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"owner_canonical_byte_writer","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: owner_canonical_byte_writer
    status: active           # ADR-0005 is Proposed
    description: "Canonical byte writers (encode_s64, encode_u32, encode_double, to_byte_array) and hashing of a var_to_bytes result are forbidden in src/kernel/, src/sim/ and block owners; owners deliver a plain Dictionary/Array/packed-array payload through snapshot(ctx) and the CanonicalEncoder encodes it. They are allowed in src/shared/det/ and tests; src/save/ may use them for container byte layout, slot_epoch.bin and integrity hashes (payload_sha256, trailer) whose output never feeds H64 or state_hash."
    why: "One injectivity argument, one set of golden vectors, one diff tool; per-owner layouts diverge on float, string and tombstone handling. Container layout and integrity hashing are not state hashing."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"stringname_sort_for_canonical_order","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: stringname_sort_for_canonical_order
    status: active           # ADR-0005 is Proposed
    description: "StringName is never passed to Array.sort() or compared for order in simulation, kernel or hashing code; convert with String(k) first. sort_custom, and any sort over keys that can tie, is banned in sim: pack the key and a stable id into one int and sort the ints."
    why: "StringName.sort() is not lexical and not a function of text (probed 2026-10-28: [&b,&a,&c,&aa,&B] sorted to [&c,&a,&b,&B,&aa]; intern-order based, may change between runs); the sort is not stable."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"global_rng_or_engine_hash_in_sim","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: global_rng_or_engine_hash_in_sim
    status: active           # ADR-0005 is Proposed; the token list itself is ADR-0010 SIM-02 and the DET rules
    description: "No global RNG token (randi, randf, randf_range, randi_range, randomize, seed(, RandomNumberGenerator, shuffle, pick_random), hash(), get_instance_id() or ResourceUID in src/sim, src/kernel or any presentation file whose output a save or test can observe; randomness is RngFacet streams, variation is Ihash. Iterating a Dictionary without sorted keys is banned."
    why: "Global generators and engine hashes are not a stable contract and depend on call order; unsorted iteration depends on insertion history."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"restore_epoch_outside_draw_epoch","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: restore_epoch_outside_draw_epoch
    status: active           # ADR-0005 is Proposed
    description: "restore_epoch (owned by Save/Load, ADR-0006; a read-only non-persisted non-hashed copy sits in kernel.clock) is read only inside RngFacet.draw_epoch; no block stores it, no canonical byte string or hash includes it, and no owner computes rng_counter + RESTORE_KEY_STRIDE * restore_epoch. The Graph's draws and every persisted counter use plain draw."
    why: "Keeps G4 defined on (save bytes, restore_epoch), makes the threat re-keying impossible to misapply (OQ-6), and keeps quit and death from rerolling physical outcomes."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"presentation_calls_det_rng_derive","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: presentation_calls_det_rng_derive
    status: active           # ADR-0005 is Proposed; amends ADR-0009 line 137 (TD-28)
    description: "Presentation never calls DetRng.derive or any rng_derive form. A truth-channel visual that must be reproducible (the Failure & Trail trail.vis variant, phase and flip) uses Ihash keyed by world_seed and a fixed per-system seed; other presentation variation uses Ihash or Ihash.h32 with a fixed non-zero seed."
    why: "The simulation never draws the trail.vis stream, so Ihash reproduces it exactly without opening the sim RNG API to presentation; a lint row allowing .vis names was rejected."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"utility_function_names_and_variant_cast","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: utility_function_names_and_variant_cast
    status: active           # ADR-0005 is Proposed; enforced by engine SHADOWED_* and UNSAFE_CAST at error (ADR-0010 5.1)
    description: "No member, parameter or local is named after a GlobalScope or GDScript utility function (seed, hash, min, max, floor, round, sign, range, len, str, type) or after a sibling member or function; no 'as' cast of a Variant (unpack with typeof plus a typed assignment, Array[T].assign(d.keys()), only in the allow-listed canonical_encoder.gd)."
    why: "SHADOWED_VARIABLE, SHADOWED_VARIABLE_BASE_CLASS, SHADOWED_GLOBAL_IDENTIFIER and UNSAFE_CAST make these load errors under the project warning gate (probed 2026-10-28)."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"performance_budgets","name":"block_hash_sha256_150kb","entry_yaml":"  - system: block_hash_sha256_150kb
    status: active           # ADR-0005 is Proposed; probed 0.33 ms on the dev machine editor binary, release-export RM-DECK measurement pending (S0-d)
    budget_ms: 1.0
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    notes: "HashingContext SHA-256 over about 150 KB of canonical bytes (TR-lsg-037); a quiet tick performs 0 canonical encodes; a cached read after a tick that touched k blocks performs k encodes; the encoder cost for Dictionary-heavy blocks is unmeasured (S0-e)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"payload_size_check","entry_yaml":"payload_size_check (api_decisions, ADR-0002): add docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md to referenced_by (ADR-0005 repeats 'var_to_bytes bytes are never hash input' as canonical_encoding / state_hash_function not-lists)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"write_outside_writescope_or_setter_dirty","entry_yaml":"write_outside_writescope_or_setter_dirty (forbidden_patterns, ADR-0003): add docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md to referenced_by (the hash cache is validated by the touch serial advanced by open_for, never by a setter; a write outside a scope is the stale-cache case)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"fault_domain_table","entry_yaml":"fault_domain_table (state_ownership, ADR-0003): add docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md to referenced_by (duplicate RNG stream name or key collision uses domain-0 DUPLICATE_ID code 8; encoder errors in a capture use CAPTURE_ERROR code 7; no new domain-0 codes)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"restore_epoch","entry_yaml":"restore_epoch (state_ownership, ADR-0006 candidate; owner Save/Load, persisted in slot_epoch.bin): add docs/architecture/adr-0005-determinism-keyed-rng-canonical-encoding-and-hashing.md to referenced_by (kernel.clock holds a read-only, non-persisted, non-hashed copy read only inside RngFacet.draw_epoch; ADR-0005 references the entry and does not duplicate it)"}]},{"adr":"ADR-0006","items":[{"section":"state_ownership","name":"restore_epoch","entry_yaml":"  - state: restore_epoch
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed; entries become binding when it is Accepted
    owner_system: save-load (SaveService)
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    interface: "u32 in the per-slot pair user://saves/<campaign_id>/slot_epoch_a.bin and slot_epoch_b.bin (12 bytes each: u32 LE epoch, u32 LE seq, u32 LE hand-rolled CRC32 poly 0xEDB88320 of the first 8 bytes); the reader takes the valid file with the higher seq, the writer overwrites the older file in place (no rename, no remove); durable (EPOCH_DURABLE re-read) before request_restore; reaches the sim only as the request_restore / request_new_game argument and the read-only non-persisted non-hashed kernel.clock view (T, world_seed, restore_epoch), read only inside RngFacet.draw_epoch; each WORLD generation header carries a read-only write-time recovery copy; advance = min(2^32-1, max(e_mem, e_slot)+1), carried (no advance) only for a Continue of the newest non-demoted QUIT generation; single registry entry, ADR-0005 references it"
    write_access: save-load-only (written by the Save/Load worker)
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"state_ownership","name":"save_ring_and_campaign_directory","entry_yaml":"  - state: save_ring_and_campaign_directory
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    owner_system: save-load (SaveService)
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    interface: "user://saves/<campaign_id>/ holds campaign.json (rebuildable hint), gen_0..gen_2.sav (ring of AUTOSAVE_GENERATIONS 3, ordered by header generation only), gen_<write_epoch>_<k>.tmp, .bak, .demoted, slot_epoch_a.bin and slot_epoch_b.bin, campaign.lock (Windows best effort), quarantine/g<generation>_<REASON>_<k>.sav; profile.sav + permanent profile.bak reserved until the first PROFILE block; retired campaigns move to user://saves_retired/<campaign_id>/; Save/Load registers no state block and no hook"
    write_access: save-load-worker-only (one Thread per WriteJob; main thread polls)
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"save_host_api","entry_yaml":"  - contract: save_host_api
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    pattern: direct_call     # host-local reads and calls, never commands
    producer: save-load
    consumers:
      - chart-table-menus
      - hud-and-suit-layer
      - debug-overlay
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    signal_signature: "SaveService (RefCounted, src/save/) new_game(world_seed: int) -> int; continue_campaign() -> int; save_and_quit() -> int (returns promptly); cancel_held_close() -> void; campaign_info() -> SaveInfo; list_saves() -> Array[SaveInfo]; retire_campaign(id) / delete_campaign(id) -> int; poll_frame() -> void and on_close_request() -> void called only by SaveHost (src/game/save_host.gd, thin Node, PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS, ProcessPriority.HOST_SERVICE); reads save_status (IDLE, WRITING, WRITTEN, FAILED), fail_escalated, restore_reason, restore_epoch (diagnostic); no save_now and no load(generation) outside dev builds"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"save_container_file","entry_yaml":"  - contract: save_container_file
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    pattern: shared_resource # on-disk file shared by writer, loader, tools and tests
    producer: save-load
    consumers:
      - save-load-loader
      - dump-save-dev-tool
      - golden-fixture-tests
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    signal_signature: "7-byte magic 53 59 4E 53 45 41 1A + layout id byte; u32 LE header_len; UTF-8 JSON header (closed field list incl. seats, per-block block_state_hash and enc_len; 64-bit values as exact-width lowercase hex64 via ADR-0005 Hex64, campaign_id an opaque 32-char lowercase hex String; other numbers integral and < 2^53; created_unix display-only); block payloads = var_to_bytes(Dictionary) concatenated in block-table order; last 32 bytes = SHA-256 of all preceding bytes (format law)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"block_persistence_payload","entry_yaml":"  - contract: block_persistence_payload
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: every-persisted-block-owner
    consumers:
      - save-load
      - command-simulation-layer
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    signal_signature: "snapshot(ctx) -> ctx.put(Dictionary): deep copy (packed arrays duplicated, never live references), plain data (null, bool, int64, finite float, String, Array, Dictionary with String or int keys, PackedByteArray/Int32Array/Int64Array; never Object, StringName, Vector2i or other vectors); canonical bytes are the kernel's, never stored; restore(data: Dictionary, stored_version: int, ctx) validates into scratch then copies contents into the existing block object and reports failure only through ctx.fault(<OWNER>_RESTORE_*); a field that may exceed 2^53 is declared int64 in the owner schema"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
      - docs/architecture/adr-0003-state-block-registry-and-owner-contract.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"save_observation_set","entry_yaml":"  - contract: save_observation_set
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    pattern: direct_call     # polled read views, no subscription
    producer: owner-read-views
    consumers:
      - save-load
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    signal_signature: "Save/Load subscribes to nothing; SaveService.poll_frame() (called once per frame by SaveHost) polls kernel.clock, controller loco_state and carry_ref, suit vitals_state and carried_id, graph failures, attention.view, assembly ragged_breach_open() and last_shape_change_T(), interaction last_salvage_T(), and the conditional web.state monotonic counters pod_arrived_seq / berthed_seq (required of the Web Map ADR; absent means the trigger never fires); last-seen copies are host-local and re-read after a load"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"performance_budgets","name":"save_main_thread_encode","entry_yaml":"  - system: save_main_thread_encode_and_handoff
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    budget_ms: 4.0
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    notes: "SAVE_ENCODE_BUDGET_MS 4 ms log-only threshold on var_to_bytes plus hand-off, additive to the kernel capture (SNAPSHOT_BUDGET_MS 16.7 ceiling); one frame per autosave above the 14.9 ms desktop target accepted pending SAVE-WRK-1-ACCEPT f (synthetic) and SAVE-WRK-1-SLICE (real blocks); probed 2026-10-28 synthetic only"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"performance_budgets","name":"save_load_type_walk","entry_yaml":"  - system: save_load_type_walk
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    budget_ms: 4.0
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    notes: "target at most 4 ms at 30 000 nodes on the load-side bounded type walk (hot-copy worker when possible); MAX_DECODE_NODES provisional 100 000 until SAVE-WRK-1 f measures it; UNVERIFIED"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"save_payload_encoding","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: save_payload_encoding
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed; SAVE-WRK-1 confirms on a release export
    api: "var_to_bytes(dictionary) per block, decoded with bytes_to_var only after trailer, block table and payload_sha256 pass, then a bounded type walk (MAX_DECODE_DEPTH 16, MAX_DECODE_NODES provisional 100000) that rejects TYPE_OBJECT, StringName, vectors and non-finite floats; the worker re-decodes and walks what it wrote in VERIFYING"
    not: "var_to_bytes_with_objects / bytes_to_var_with_objects; Resource, .tres, .res, ResourceLoader or load() for a save; JSON or base64 payloads; trusting the encoder to refuse objects (it encodes an Object as EncodedObjectAsID, probed 2026-10-28); storing canonical bytes"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    reason: "Native, exact int64 (probed 2^53+1), one decode path and one fuzz target; stored bytes are not canonical, so state equality is state_hash and hash input is ADR-0005's canonical encoding"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"hex64_header_decode","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: hex64_header_decode
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    api: "ADR-0005 Hex64.encode / Hex64.decode (src/shared/det/): exactly 16 lowercase [0-9a-f] validated by a loop, then hex_decode + decode_s64; resize(8) before encode_s64; campaign_id is an opaque 32-char lowercase hex String validated by a loop and never converted to an int; header integers must be integral and strictly < 2^53"
    not: "String.hex_to_int (saturates to INT64_MAX with an engine error, probed 2026-10-28); to_int(); hex_decode on unvalidated text (accepts uppercase, logs on bad input); any 64-bit or hashed value as a JSON number; a second 64-bit codec in src/save/"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    reason: "JSON.parse returns float for every number (2^53+1 parses to 2^53, probed); top-bit-set values read as negative GDScript ints by design"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"save_worker_thread","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: save_worker_thread
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed; SAVE-WRK-1 confirms
    api: "one Thread per WriteJob (RefCounted holding the Thread and a Mutex-guarded status record), started with thread.start(WriteWorker.run.bind(...)) whose Error is checked; ownership transfer of handed-over objects (no retained alias, or .duplicate() / .duplicate(true); the worker never mutates, appends to or resizes an argument); only pre-globalised absolute paths; jobs kept in SaveService.jobs until reaped; main thread polls is_alive() and calls wait_to_finish() only on a dead thread; Save & Quit polls under SAVE_QUIT_TIMEOUT_MS on the injected Clock then request_shutdown; abandoned jobs are never killed"
    not: "WorkerThreadPool; joining a live thread; call_deferred / set_deferred / call_thread_safe; Callable(WriteWorker, \"run\"); passing the worker a Node, block, read view or live-state container; dropping a live job"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    reason: "Packed arrays, Arrays and Dictionaries are reference-shared in GDScript (probed 2026-10-28), so immutability is by ownership transfer; Thread.wait_to_finish takes no timeout; a stuck disk must cost a stale file, not a stuck frame; a live sleeping thread did not delay exit past 0.68 s"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"save_file_swap","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: save_file_swap
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    api: "generation swap: write gen_<write_epoch>_<k>.tmp, flush, close, re-open, re-hash, decode + walk; rename the position's old file to .bak; rename .tmp to the now-absent gen_k.sav; re-hash; delete .bak; every store_* and rename result checked; campaign.json uses temp + rename-over as an accepted non-atomic exposure; slot_epoch uses two alternating files overwritten in place (no rename, no remove)"
    not: "rename-over-existing for generations or the epoch (probably remove-then-rename on Windows, so not atomic, UNVERIFIED); describing rename-over as atomic or 'old file intact' across a crash; overwriting a generation in place; deleting a generation before its successor verified"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    reason: "Every partial state is recoverable by T-6; sharing violations leave the target intact; a valid epoch file always exists"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"campaign_lock","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: campaign_lock
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed; Linux/Deck behaviour UNVERIFIED (SAVE-WRK-1 g)
    api: "hold a FileAccess handle on campaign.lock as a SaveService member for the campaign lifetime (never a local, never reassigned; is_open() asserted per frame poll); a second process renames the file to campaign.lock.probe and back (only when the file exists; missing means not held); failure means held, so open READ_ONLY; Windows-only best effort, deferrable to Alpha"
    not: "an exclusive FileAccess.open (WRITE-open is not exclusive, probed 2026-10-28); OS.is_process_running liveness checks on a foreign pid"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    reason: "Held files cannot be renamed or removed on Windows (probed); the handle dies with the process so no stale lock exists; the probe/startup race is an accepted exposure"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"save_close_request","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: save_close_request
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed; SAVE-WRK-1 e confirms
    api: "SaveHost sets get_tree().auto_accept_quit = false and forwards NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST / NOTIFICATION_WM_GO_BACK_REQUEST to SaveService.on_close_request(), routed by kernel state (TR-saveload-039), polled under SAVE_QUIT_TIMEOUT_MS, never blocking; request_shutdown is the only place get_tree().quit() is reached"
    not: "the default auto-accepted quit; get_tree().quit() from Save/Load or the host; a blocking wait for the writer"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    reason: "The window X, Alt+F4 and OS shutdown otherwise exit at once and cut a write in flight (probed exit 0.68 s)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"object_or_resource_in_save_payload","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: object_or_resource_in_save_payload
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    description: "No save, snapshot, profile or staged payload contains an Object, Resource, StringName, Vector2i or other vector/rect, Callable, Signal, RID, NodePath or non-finite float; the type walk enforces it at write (VERIFYING) and at load; var_to_bytes_with_objects, bytes_to_var_with_objects and Resource-based saves are never used."
    why: "var_to_bytes silently encodes an Object as EncodedObjectAsID (probed 2026-10-28), so the encoder is not a defence; a .tres can embed scripts."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"join_live_save_thread_or_workerthreadpool","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: join_live_save_thread_or_workerthreadpool
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    description: "Nothing calls wait_to_finish on a Thread that is still alive, uses WorkerThreadPool for the save writer, drops a live WriteJob, or blocks the main thread on save I/O; Thread is legal only inside src/save/, one per WriteJob."
    why: "The join takes no timeout; a hung write would hang the frame at DEAD or at quit (CR-1a, exactly one thread boundary); a freed live Thread orphans its worker."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"alias_after_save_handoff","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: alias_after_save_handoff
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    description: "After a buffer is handed to the save worker the main thread keeps no alias to it, or hands over .duplicate() / .duplicate(true); neither side appends to, resizes or mutates a handed-over object."
    why: "Packed arrays, Arrays and Dictionaries are reference-shared across threads in GDScript (probed 2026-10-28); there is no copy-on-write protection."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"hex_to_int_on_64bit_field","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: hex_to_int_on_64bit_field
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    description: "No 64-bit header or hash field is parsed with String.hex_to_int, int() or to_int(), or read from a JSON number; decode with ADR-0005 Hex64.decode after its exact-width lowercase pre-check."
    why: "hex_to_int saturates at INT64_MAX with an engine error, hex_decode accepts uppercase, and JSON numbers are floats that corrupt values from 2^53 up (probed 2026-10-28)."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"restore_epoch_in_hash_or_snapshot","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: restore_epoch_in_hash_or_snapshot
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    description: "restore_epoch is never inside a block snapshot payload, a state_hash or block hash input, or a rewritten generation file; request_restore is called only after EPOCH_DURABLE (or the logged SL_EPOCH_NOT_DURABLE failure path); a step-back, demotion, quarantine or lost manifest never lowers it."
    why: "Keeps every generation immutable after VERIFYING so REBASED baselines hold, and keeps quit and death from being a reroll oracle (R13/R14)."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"wall_clock_in_save_ordering","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: wall_clock_in_save_ordering
    status: active           # ADR-0006 is Proposed
    description: "created_unix and the SaveInfo time (WallClock port) are display metadata only; no ordering, gate, hash or sim input reads them; every millisecond timeout reads the injected Clock port."
    why: "The generation number is the only order; wall time is banned in src/ outside the SIM-02 allow-list (ADR-0010, TD-11)."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"control_plane","entry_yaml":"control_plane: add docs/architecture/adr-0006-save-container-generations-versioning-and-restore-epoch.md to referenced_by (Save/Load is the producer of request_snapshot() -> void with its result in the outcome handler, request_restore(payload, restore_epoch, expected_state_hash: int, has_expected_hash: bool), request_new_game, request_shutdown; the restore payload is a Dictionary StringName block_id -> {schema_version, data}; the signature is owned by ADR-0002)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"owner_callable_contract","entry_yaml":"owner_callable_contract: add ADR-0006 to referenced_by (snapshot/restore/default_state/post_restore payload rules; failure only through ctx.fault; every typed-return override returns on all paths)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"block_as_resource_or_node","entry_yaml":"block_as_resource_or_node: add ADR-0006 to referenced_by (two-phase restore copies contents into the existing block object; no Resource saves)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"fault_domain_table","entry_yaml":"fault_domain_table: add ADR-0006 to referenced_by (domain 1 save_load registered by Save/Load at BOOTING through the BOOTING-only registrar facet with the SL_PRECHECK_/SL_WRITE_/SL_LOAD_/SL_VERIFY_/SL_EPOCH_/SL_QUIT_/SL_NEW_GAME_/SL_BOOT_ closed sets; NAMES indexed by local code; none faults the kernel)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"kernel_autoload_or_global","entry_yaml":"kernel_autoload_or_global: add ADR-0006 to referenced_by (SaveService and SaveHost are constructed and injected by the composition root; no autoload)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"static_content_catalogs","entry_yaml":"static_content_catalogs / content_loading: add ADR-0006 to referenced_by (Save/Load knobs as a ScalarTable and assets/data/saveload/block_versions.json load through the ADR-0007 pipeline in the composition root and are injected into SaveService.setup() as plain data; catalogue_version int goes in the header)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"frame_order","entry_yaml":"frame_order: add ADR-0006 to referenced_by (SaveHost uses ProcessPriority.HOST_SERVICE -40, after TICK_DRIVER and before PRESENTATION; constant owned by ADR-0001)"}]},{"adr":"ADR-0008","items":[{"section":"state_ownership","name":"render_geometry_and_viewport_stack","entry_yaml":"  - state: render_geometry_and_viewport_stack
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed; entries become binding when it is Accepted
    owner_system: pixel-perfect-render-pipeline (PipelineRoot, ViewportWiring, CameraHost)
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    interface: "RenderLayout (read-only RefCounted value: k_auto, k_base, k_z, h, field_px, picture_rect, world_rect, hud_rect, hud_canvas; no version field) via PipelineRoot.layout, with PipelineRoot.layout_version as the change counter; world SubViewport size and override, WorldContainer position and scale, every CanvasLayer scale and offset and HudRoot size are written only by PipelineRoot and ViewportWiring; the world canvas_transform and parallax offsets only by the CameraHost frame_pre_draw handler; presentation, the Filter, Lighting, HUD and Chart Table read the layout and call world_to_hud; never a state block, never saved, never hashed"
    write_access: pipeline-root-only
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"state_ownership","name":"present_time","entry_yaml":"  - state: present_time
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    owner_system: pixel-perfect-render-pipeline (PipelineRoot)
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    interface: "PipelineRoot.present_time (read-only float seconds): advanced in step 1 of PipelineRoot._process by the delta while PresentationClock.state is RUNNING, SAVING or LOADING-with-hold, frozen while PAUSED, never scaled by reduced motion; delivered to presenters as PresentFrame.present_time; the clock for all layer-0 cosmetic animation; presentation-only, never hashed or saved"
    write_access: pipeline-root-only
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
      - docs/architecture/adr-0001-kernel-tick-driver-and-frame-order.md   # handed ownership to the pipeline root
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"render_layout","entry_yaml":"  - contract: render_layout
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: pixel-perfect-render-pipeline (PipelineRoot)
    consumers:
      - hud-and-suit-layer
      - in-world-instruments
      - chart-table-and-menus
      - input-adapter
      - 2d-lighting-and-occlusion
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    signal_signature: "RenderLayout.derive(window_px: Vector2i, settings: DisplaySettings, zoom_k: int, tuning: RenderTuning, offered_h: Array[int]) -> RenderLayout (static, pure; offered_h duplicated on entry); world_to_hud(body_pos: Vector2i, pose_q: Vector2i) -> Vector2i (the only form); mouse_to_world_aim(cursor_px: Vector2i, f_q: Vector2i) -> Vector2 (open loop, D.14b); mouse_to_world_view(cursor_px: Vector2i, pose_q: Vector2i) -> Vector2 (never for beam aim); PipelineRoot.layout (read-only), PipelineRoot.layout_version (read-only)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"filter_hook_slot","entry_yaml":"  - contract: filter_hook_slot
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: perception-filter
    consumers:
      - pixel-perfect-render-pipeline
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    signal_signature: "PipelineRoot.set_filter_material(material: ShaderMaterial) -> void (sole writer of SubViewportContainer.material; null at MVP because the world viewport is SDR; with the HDR contingency adopted the slot always holds the resolve material and the Filter shader includes the resolve); published filter_route: PER_ELEMENT | NOT_USED"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"zoom_request","entry_yaml":"  - contract: zoom_request
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    pattern: direct_call     # host-local presentation call, not a command; never saved
    producer: input-adapter
    consumers:
      - pixel-perfect-render-pipeline
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    signal_signature: "PipelineRoot.request_zoom_step(direction: int) -> void (+1 in, -1 out; edge-triggered; one accepted step per frame and >= 0.15 s apart on the _process delta divided by Engine.time_scale; surplus discarded); PipelineRoot.apply_display_settings(settings: DisplaySettings) -> void (marks dirty only; DisplaySettings is persisted host-locally by the Chart Table SettingsStore, CT-19, ADR-0030)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"renderer_and_windows_driver","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: renderer_and_windows_driver
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed; PROVISIONAL until lighting spike steps 1, 2, 9 and pipeline spike steps 11, 12
    api: "rendering/renderer/rendering_method = forward_plus; rendering/rendering_device/driver.windows = vulkan and driver.linuxbsd = vulkan, asserted by effective ProjectSettings value in CI and by the live driver name at boot; required keys fallback_to_opengl3 = false and fallback_to_d3d12 = false (fallback_to_vulkan = false if the D3D12 reversal is taken); rendering/driver/threads/thread_model held at default 1 and asserted; a release build treats a method or driver mismatch as a fatal unsupported-GPU screen"
    not: "Compatibility or Mobile renderer; Direct3D 12 on Windows unless the spike tie-break fires (Vulkan fails a correctness check D3D12 passes, or D3D12 beats Vulkan P99 CPU frame time by >= 10 % on RM-DESKTOP); relying on the engine default driver; silent driver fallback; thread_model 2; a release build that logs a wrong method and continues"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    reason: "Forward+ for Light2D and glow parity and the gated HDR contingency (Compatibility ignores use_hdr_2d, probed); RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK are specified in Vulkan terms; a key-absent project reports vulkan on 4.7.2 (windowed probe) while the reference says D3D12 since 4.6, so only an effective-value assertion is safe; the fallback keys default true and would silently ship a Compatibility look"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"world_viewport_wiring","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: world_viewport_wiring
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    api: "Root Window content_scale_mode DISABLED; world SubViewport (size field_px under pass A, field_px * k_z with size_2d_override = field_px and size_2d_override_stretch = true under pass B; use_hdr_2d = false at MVP; UPDATE_ONCE mandatory on any resize while UPDATE_DISABLED, desired mode tracked in ViewportWiring) inside a SubViewportContainer (stretch false, scale (k_z, k_z) under A, texture_filter NEAREST, material null at MVP); CanvasLayers hold 1, HUD 2 (scale (H, H)), MenuPixel 3, MenuReading 4, Debug 5, distinct indices; ViewportWiring.Mode {A, B} is a constructor argument, pass A built at MVP; all written only by PipelineRoot / ViewportWiring"
    not: "root canvas_items / integer stretch to obtain k, H or k_z; SubViewportContainer.stretch_shrink as the primary (floors, 3840/7 gives 548); a pass-B viewport sized to the window (an override that does not divide the size gives a non-integer scale); a Control under the world viewport; two CanvasLayers sharing an index; reading render_target_update_mode back as state; Mode as a const read inside the class"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    reason: "Probed: root integer stretch is exact only at H = k and the default zoom; CanvasLayer.scale and a stretch=false container scale give exact independent integers; an override that does not divide the size gives 2.0029 not 2; a resize of a disabled viewport blanks it; same-index layers rely on a sibling-order tie-break"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"world_viewport_sdr_at_mvp","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: world_viewport_sdr_at_mvp
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed; HDR decided by lighting spike steps 7 and 8
    api: "World SubViewport use_hdr_2d = false and root rendering/viewport/hdr_2d = false at MVP, so palette fills read back exact; the HDR path (use_hdr_2d = true) is adopted only by amending ADR-0008 together with a mandatory PipelineRoot-owned resolve material in the container slot (exact linear-to-sRGB plus a clamp or tonemap policy, included by the Filter shader, gated on the effective rendering method, absent under Compatibility); windowed palette read-back test per renderer"
    not: "use_hdr_2d = true on a viewport drawn through a SubViewportContainer without a resolve (outputs unconverted linear colour: (128,64,200) reads (55,13,147)); a resolve under Compatibility (double-converts to (188,137,229)); use_debanding unless flat fills read back bit-exact with it on"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    reason: "Windowed probe 4.7.2 Forward+: an HDR viewport on the SDR root is not sRGB-converted; Compatibility silently ignores use_hdr_2d, so the fix is renderer-specific"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"zoom_via_logical_size","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: zoom_via_logical_size
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    api: "Zoom step k_z in [ZOOM_MIN_K, k_base + 2] changes the world viewport logical size and the container scale in one RESCALING frame (a camera cut); ZOOM_MIN_K is a typed row table (k_base, target class, min_k) in RenderTuning loaded by ADR-0007's pipeline"
    not: "Camera2D.zoom, any tweened or non-integer scale, a runtime-measured ladder, queued zoom presses"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    reason: "Camera2D.zoom has no pixel-snap member; Lighting lengths stay in base px independent of k_z (LO-16); a mid-session ladder change would be a player-visible surprise"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"camera_canvas_transform_write","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: camera_canvas_transform_write
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed; ordering probed on a 4.7.2 dev build, release export UNVERIFIED (spike step 12)
    api: "CameraSolver.solve runs in the CAMERA_SOLVE stage (ADR-0009 stage 1) of PipelineRoot._process and publishes pose_q, f_q, jolt, parallax offsets and the world_to_hud inputs; the CameraHost RenderingServer.frame_pre_draw handler only writes the world SubViewport canvas_transform and the parallax offsets from the solved values (idempotent, branch-free, safe if skipped); primary variant has no Camera2D in the world tree; fallback if step 12 rejects the hook: the write moves to the last statement of PipelineRoot._process after driver.frame (no new ProcessPriority constant)"
    not: "solving inside the frame_pre_draw handler (HUD, Avatar presenter and mouse_to_world_aim would read the previous frame's pose); a Camera2D scroll on its own clock; Camera2D.limit_*; a camera parented to a body; any writer other than the pipeline root, ViewportWiring or the camera host; subscribers drawing from their own _process; ProcessPriority.PRESENTATION_LATE"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    reason: "Probed: frame_pre_draw fires after every _process and before the draw, so a solve in it is invisible to the HUD stage; a write in the handler or in _process is drawn the same frame"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"nearest_filter_three_places","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: nearest_filter_three_places
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    api: "NEAREST set in three places: project default_texture_filter = 0, world SubViewport.canvas_item_default_texture_filter = Viewport.DEFAULT_CANVAS_ITEM_TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST (0), SubViewportContainer.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST (1); mipmaps off on drawn sheets; SubViewport.size and TileSet.tile_size (48x48) set explicitly; snap_2d members set on the world viewport in code (they snap in base-pixel space in both passes; nothing relies on them)"
    not: "inheriting the container filter (probed default 0 = PARENT_NODE), relying on project settings reaching the SubViewport, the 512x512 SubViewport default, a 16x16 tile_size"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    reason: "Probed: project default filter is linear (1), SubViewport members default false / 1 independently, two differently numbered enums; any miss blurs the pass-A upscale"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"canvas_coordinate_exactness","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: canvas_coordinate_exactness
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    api: "Presentation coordinates are integer-valued float32, exact for |v| <= 2^24 base px; Vector2i is converted to Vector2 only at Placement.put and at the canvas_transform write; pose_q is Vector2i quantised from the solver's float64 scalars before that conversion; world and body-frame extents stay below 2^24 base px (ADR-0015 owns the bound if body-frame extents could exceed it; the rebase mechanism keeps coordinates inside it); unit test at 2^24 - 1, 2^24 and 2^24 + 1"
    not: "a non-integer-valued presentation coordinate; silent float32 rounding of a canvas origin"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    reason: "Transform2D, Node2D.position and Control.position are float32 in the standard build; closes the float32 canvas exactness reference of ADR-0005 TR-shipbody-038 and ADR-0010"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28
    revised: """},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"viewport_geometry_written_outside_pipeline_root","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: viewport_geometry_written_outside_pipeline_root
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    description: "Only PipelineRoot and ViewportWiring (src/presentation/pipeline/viewport_wiring.gd) write SubViewport.size and size_2d_override*, the world container's position, scale, stretch_shrink and material, any CanvasLayer scale, offset or transform, and HudRoot.size; only the CameraHost frame_pre_draw handler writes the world canvas_transform and the parallax offsets; no subscriber, the Filter, Lighting, HUD or Chart Table writes a viewport or camera property; no code but RenderLayout.derive computes k, H, world_to_hud or the cursor mapping."
    why: "Two writers or a re-derived projection produce fractional transforms and disagreeing HUD anchors (TR-pxl-003, TR-pxl-019); the pixel-integrity promise needs one source."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"root_stretch_or_camera2d_zoom_for_scale","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: root_stretch_or_camera2d_zoom_for_scale
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    description: "No root canvas_items or integer stretch to obtain k, H or k_z; no Camera2D.zoom, no tweened or non-integer scale, no Control.scale on HUD nodes, no scale animation anywhere in the world or HUD."
    why: "Root stretch is exact only when H equals k at the default zoom (probed), so it cannot host the Deck's world 2x and HUD 3x; non-integer scale is the failure the pipeline exists to prevent."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"control_or_reading_text_under_world_or_scaled_layer","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: control_or_reading_text_under_world_or_scaled_layer
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    description: "No Control and no node in group hud under the world SubViewport; no reading-face (vector) text under an integer-scaled CanvasLayer or the world container; reading-face text lives on a scale (1,1) layer (MenuReadingLayer, layer 4) with sizes in screen px; HUD text uses bitmap faces or configured oversampling."
    why: "A Control under the world receives world light and the Filter (HR-1); text under an integer scale is bitmap-stretched and blurs."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"render_mode_branch_outside_viewport_wiring","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: render_mode_branch_outside_viewport_wiring
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    description: "ViewportWiring.Mode (pass A or B) is a constructor argument read only inside ViewportWiring; no other class branches on it, and no rule, formula or dependent may assume which pass is live."
    why: "A and B must be identical in coordinate space, sort contract, camera contract and HUD (PR-7); a leak of the mode makes the spike result a rewrite."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"camera_solve_inside_frame_pre_draw","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: camera_solve_inside_frame_pre_draw
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    description: "CameraSolver.solve is called only from the CAMERA_SOLVE stage inside PipelineRoot._process; the frame_pre_draw handler performs the two canvas writes from already-solved values and never solves; no presenter defines its own _process; PipelineRoot is the only PresentationHost."
    why: "frame_pre_draw fires after every _process (probed), so a solve in it leaves world_to_hud, the beam pose and the aim mapping one frame behind the world (PR-6 C11, TR-pxl-019)."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0008-render-pipeline-wiring-and-integer-scaling.md
    added: 2026-10-28"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"silent_renderer_or_driver_fallback","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: silent_renderer_or_driver_fallback
    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed
    description: "project.godot must set rendering_device/fallback_to_opengl3 = false and fallback_to_d3d12 = false while Vulkan is the pin; a release build that finds a wrong effective rendering method or driver shows a fatal unsupported-GPU screen and never logs and continues."
    why: "A silent degrade to Compatibility ships a different look (use_hdr_2d ignored, Light2D and glow differ, colour path changes) with only a diagnostics-header line."

    status: active           # ADR-0008 is Proposed; all figures pending release-export spike on RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK; figures owned by the Pipeline GDD D.16, mirrored in ADR-0008 s7

Render targets <= 3 MB (A) / 22 MB (B) at 1080p."
